Sum within each acquisition. S1 A: 10 + 20 + 5 = 35 S1 C: 40 S2 A: 70 S2 C: no positive value  Input = output = 145. Sum conservation checks accounting, not biological accuracy.

Read the resulting matrix. Rows: reporting groups Columns: acquisitions  Blank means unquantified. It does not establish biological absence. This illustrates sum quantification. directLFQ estimates quantities differently.
